in_arabic.name: زارياب
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني بالغنى و الخصب و الازدهار
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مشتق من الجذر 'ز-ر-ي' و يعني الخصب و الغنى و الازدهار. ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الحجر آية ٤٥ 'وَأَنبَتْنَاهُ بِوَادٍ مُبَارَكٍ'. يرمز الاسم إلى النمو و الازدهار و الحياة الخصبة.

in_urdu.name: زیریاب
in_urdu.meaning: نام کا مطلب ہے دولت، خوشحالی اور تروتازگی
in_urdu.long_meaning: یہ نام عربی زبان کے 'ز-ر-ي' جذر سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے دولت، خوشحالی اور تروتازگی۔ یہ اسلامی تقویم میں ایک مقدس نام ہے جو زندگی کی خوبصورتی اور تروتازگی کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: ज़रियाब
in_hindi.meaning: ज़रियाब नाम का अर्थ है समृद्धि, सुख और ताजगी
in_hindi.long_meaning: ज़रियाब नाम अरबी भाषा के 'ز-ر-ي' जड़ से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है समृद्धि, सुख और ताजगी। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है और जीवन की सुंदरता और ताजगी को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: زارياب
in_pashto.meaning: د زرياب نوم معنا دی شتمن، خوښۍ او تروتازګۍ
in_pashto.long_meaning: د زرياب نوم د عربي ژبې د 'ز-ر-ي' ريښې څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د شتمن، خوښۍ او تروتازګۍ معنی ورکوي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتني کلتور په دوديزو ارزښتونو کې ځای لري.

in_english.name: Zaryaab
in_english.meaning: Abundance, prosperity, and freshness are the meanings of this name
in_english.long_meaning: The name Zaryaab originates from the Arabic root 'ز-ر-ي' (z-r-y), which is associated with meanings such as abundance, prosperity, and freshness. This name appears in the Quran in Surah Al-Hijr, verse 45, 'And We made it grow in a blessed land.' It symbolizes growth, prosperity, and a vibrant life. In Islamic tradition, Zaryaab is considered a blessed name that reflects positive attributes and spiritual significance.

In many Islamic cultures, the names given to children are believed to have a profound influence on their lives and character, and the name Zaryaab is thought to inspire its bearer to be a beacon of light and guidance for others. It is a name that suggests resilience, strength, and the ability to bring hope and positivity to those around them.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Zaryaab" holds deep significance as it reflects the inner light and radiance that lies within every human being. In Islamic tradition, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "Allah will create for him a shining light on his left and a gloomy darkness on his right." (Bukhari). The name Zaryaab is a reminder of the profound inner light that each person possesses and is encouraged to cultivate and share with others. It also symbolizes the role that each person plays in illuminating the path for others, guiding them towards the truth and righteousness. Ultimately, the name Zaryaab is a powerful reminder of our inherent spiritual potential and the importance of living a life that reflects the light of God.
